library.title: Fact library (NS-4 long-term consistency)
library.subtitle: Click «Extract fact» inside a chapter to collect candidates; confirmed facts are automatically injected into subsequent chapters. Text edits, chapter deletions, or character deletions enter exception review and stop polluting the generation context.
library.importSuccessMsg: Candidate diff imported: {{written}} written, {{skippedDuplicate}} duplicates skipped, {{skippedInvalid}} invalid skipped.

statusHint.stale: The source text has changed and the original evidence quote no longer holds; nothing will be injected until it is reconfirmed.
statusHint.sourceMissing: The referenced character/chapter/source was deleted or cannot be mapped; manual judgment is required to decide whether to keep it.
statusHint.invalidRange: The chapters pointed to by validFrom/validTo no longer exist; they must be reset or confirmed manually.

knowledge.title: Character knowledge ledger (CONSISTENCY-2)
knowledge.subtitle: World facts and character knowledge are stored separately; only author-confirmed events enter the cognitive projection of subsequent chapters. Learning events belonging to the target chapter itself do not take effect early.
knowledge.statementPlaceholder: True proposition in-world, e.g.: the man in black is the city lord
knowledge.beliefPlaceholder: Incorrect content the character actually believes
knowledge.validationCharacterRequired: Please select a character and fill in both the stable knowledge key and the statement text.
knowledge.validationMislearnBeliefRequired: Mislearn events require the incorrect content the character actually believes.
knowledge.adoptSkippedMsg: Not written ({{count}} skipped); check for duplicates or field issues.

constitution.title: World constitution (CONSISTENCY-3)
constitution.subtitle: Scanning extracts verbatim evidence only from registered setting fields and closed subject sets; everything arrives as a candidate. When confirming, conflicting values for the same subject and topic are hard-blocked.
constitution.replaceExplicitButton: Explicitly replace conflicting old constitution with this candidate
constitution.noScanSourcesMsg: There are no scannable registered fields in the current worldview, power systems, story core, or character sheets.
constitution.scanSuccessMsg: Scanned {{sources}} source fields, parsed {{candidates}} closed-set candidates; {{written}} written, {{skipped}} skipped.
constitution.confirmSuccessMsg: Confirmed as world constitution; it will feed future generations and consistency reviews.
constitution.confirmClashMsg: Confirmation blocked: conflicting Canon {{values}} already exists for the same subject and topic. Reject the candidate, adjust the source, or handle the old assertion manually first.
constitution.confirmStaleMsg: Confirmation blocked: the source field was modified after extraction. Re-run the scan; the old candidate will no longer be injected.
constitution.confirmMissingMsg: Confirmation blocked: the source record or registered field is missing. Check the settings and re-run the scan.
constitution.confirmUnavailableMsg: This assertion cannot be confirmed right now; please refresh and retry.
constitution.replaceSuccessMsg: Explicitly replaced {{count}} old world constitutions; old assertions remain as audit records marked «superseded».
constitution.replaceLockedMsg: The old world constitution is locked and cannot be replaced. Unlock it in the fact library or preserve the old assertion.
constitution.replaceFailedMsg: Replacement failed: candidate or source state has changed; please rescan and review again.
